# Rescue & Nourish

> Food donation platform connecting donors, NGOs, and orphanages in Bangalore to reduce waste and feed children in need.

Rescue & Nourish lets donors list surplus food, NGOs coordinate pickups, and orphanages register their needs. Built-in smart matching pairs donations to the closest orphanage by location, needs, and capacity.

## Pages

- [Welcome](/welcome): Choose your role — Donor, NGO, Orphanage, or Admin.
- [Food Donations](/): Browse food donations and orphanages.
- [Medical & Requirements](/needs): Medical supplies, clothing, and other needs posted by orphanages.
- [NGO Directory](/ngos): Find and contact registered NGOs.
- [Donation Tracking](/tracking): Track donation status from pickup to delivery.
- [Smart Matching](/smart-matching): Auto-suggested donor↔orphanage pairings.
- [Analytics](/analytics): Impact metrics for the platform.

## Optional

- [Watchlist](/watchlist): Subscribe to food categories.
- [Notifications](/notifications): Realtime alerts.
